key_decisions.decision: Keeps the second family designation without inventing a precise genealogical link.
Retains all three places and their shared count with the source’s form Kiriath-arim.
Follows the source’s read form Shalmai while retaining the written form in the bound XML.
Uses the read forms Meunim and Nephusim, with both written/read annotations preserved in the source binding.
Unfolds the name-bearing relationship without implying that every listed priest had that marriage.
Retains the documentary failure and resulting exclusion, including its purity language.
Keeps the restriction, the sacred category, and the unresolved requirement for priestly discernment.
Retains the stated overall count without adjusting it to the itemized figures.
Makes enslavement and both gender distinctions explicit and keeps the additional singers separate.
Preserves the capacity-based giving, ancient units, and all amounts; units are explained separately.
